system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the simdjson JSON parser codebase. This C++ library implements a two-stage parser (structural indexing then tape building), DOM and ondemand APIs, document streaming (parse_many), number and string parsing with UTF-8/surrogate handling, and error handling. Identify subtle bugs, correctness issues, API contract drift, concurrency/race problems, tape or buffer layout issues, and numeric/encoding edge cases in core parsing and iteration paths. Focus on issues detectable via static analysis. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the tape container start packing bug in src/generic/stage2/tape_builder.h end_container where the start tape element packs count in low bits and index in high bits instead of next_tape_index in low 32 bits and saturated count in high 24 bits
Identifies the is_fatal error set bug in include/simdjson/error-inl.h is_fatal where DEPTH_ERROR is omitted from the set of fatal error codes

Identifies the float fast path power bound bug in include/simdjson/generic/numberparsing.h compute_float_64 where the fast path uses power <= 21 instead of power <= 22 in both FLT_EVAL_METHOD branches

Identifies the doc_index update bug in include/simdjson/dom/document_stream-inl.h document_stream::next where doc_index is not set to the start of the first document when loading a new batch inside the while (error == EMPTY) loop
Identifies the decimal exponent sign bug in include/simdjson/generic/numberparsing.h parse_decimal_after_separator where exponent is set to p - first_after_period instead of first_after_period - p

Identifies the stage1_worker ordering bug in include/simdjson/dom/document_stream-inl.h stage1_worker start_thread lambda where has_work = false is set before assigning stage1_thread_error from run_stage1

Identifies the empty-container matching-brace bug in src/generic/stage2/tape_builder.h empty_container where the START tape entry is written with start_index+2 instead of start_index+1 as the matching brace index, so the END slot is at start_index+1 but matching_brace_index() returns start_index+2, breaking after_element() and DOM iteration/size for empty arrays and objects.

Identifies the skip_double or skip_large_integer advance bug in src/generic/stage2/tape_writer.h where skip_double() or skip_large_integer() uses next_tape_loc += 1 (or next_tape_loc++) instead of next_tape_loc += 2, so only one slot is skipped for a two-slot type and the next tape write overwrites the second slot, corrupting the tape for documents that use doubles or large integers.
